Add sine / sine terms that can interact with covariates to include temporal variation

```{r}
load('../data/localisations/moose_random_steps.RData')
```

```{r}
moose_random_steps <- moose_random_steps %>% mutate(
  hour_s1_t1 = sin(1*pi*hour_t1/24),
  hour_s2_t1 = sin(3*pi*hour_t1/24),
  hour_s3_t1 = sin(5*pi*hour_t1/24),
  hour_c1_t1 = cos(1*pi*hour_t1/24),
  hour_c2_t1 = cos(3*pi*hour_t1/24),
  hour_c3_t1 = cos(5*pi*hour_t1/24),
  
  hour_s1_t2 = sin(1*pi*hour_t2/24),
  hour_s2_t2 = sin(3*pi*hour_t2/24),
  hour_s3_t2 = sin(5*pi*hour_t2/24),
  hour_c1_t2 = cos(1*pi*hour_t2/24),
  hour_c2_t2 = cos(3*pi*hour_t2/24),
  hour_c3_t2 = cos(5*pi*hour_t2/24),
)
```

```{r}
save(moose_random_steps, file='../data/localisations/moose_random_steps.RData')
```
